description.text: GX Starter Deck: Double Burst, a Sun & Moon series product: a random 60-card deck, ready to play, with damage counters, GX markers and a rule book; each deck always held one Pokémon-GX, along with Trainer cards often played in battles. This set holds every card the decks could contain. Its pool includes TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX such as Celebi & Venusaur-GX and Gengar & Mimikyu-GX.
